documented_probe: Covering task for C-97ca5dea (compute round accuracy excluding invalid and unmatched pairs). Distinct from cedar-jetty: file-based CLI reconciliation of two JSON round files with exact numeric matching and a cross-round totals block, instead of an in-module function with tolerance comparison.
notes: Single-stage: reconcile two JSON files per round, drop invalid/unmatched pairs, half-up rounding to 3 decimals, null accuracy when no valid pairs. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (pair/validity/boundary logic), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (hidden cases probe ties, invalid markers, empty inputs), quantitative_correctness (exact ints and half-up-rounded ratios).
